title: execSync invoked in McpMissionBridge for Git metadata
risk: Hardcoded git rev-parse and git branch commands. No user input is interpolated; arguments are fixed literals.
remediation: Wrap child_process calls with try/catch and bounded timeouts.

title: Protected surface path normalization against symlinks
risk: Uses path.resolve(rawPath). On platforms supporting complex symlinks, path canonicalization via fs.realpathSync is recommended.
remediation: Add fs.realpathSync check where paths exist on disk.
